key.name: latitude
key.description: Degrees north (negative for south), for working out sunrise and sunset.

key.name: longitude
key.description: Degrees east (negative for west), for working out sunrise and sunset.

key.name: morning-time
key.description: Minutes after midnight that sunrise is pulled toward, by "rhythm-weight".

key.name: evening-time
key.description: Minutes after midnight that sunset is pulled toward, by "rhythm-weight".

key.name: rhythm-weight
key.description: How far, in percent, sunrise and sunset are pulled toward "morning-time" and "evening-time". 0 follows the sun; 100 keeps to the set times.

key.name: auto
key.description: Whether brightness follows the sun. Moving the slider turns this off until the next sunrise or sunset.

key.name: resume-at
key.summary: When to follow the sun again
key.description: Unix time at which "auto" turns itself back on, or 0 when it was switched off by hand.

key.name: night-level
key.description: Brightness, 0–100, once civil twilight has ended.

key.name: monitors
key.description: JSON object keyed by EDID id ("MFG:MODEL:SERIAL"). Each entry has "model", "connector", "enabled", and "lowest" and "highest": the monitor's brightness, in percent of its range, at levels 0 and 100.
